Villa for rent in Al Habtoor Polo Resort and Club - The Residences, Dubai Land

Step into refined luxury at Al Habtoor Polo Resort and Club - The Residences, a prestigious villa set in the serene and highly sought-after community of Dubai Land. This 4-bedroom, 5-bathroom home offers a perfect balance of elegance, comfort, and resort-style living. Ideal for families or those seeking an exclusive lifestyle, this residence promises privacy, sophistication, and access to world-class amenities.
.
Property Highlights:

Spacious 4 bedrooms, each with en-suite bathrooms
3,797 sq. ft. of elegantly designed living space
Open-plan living and dining areas ideal for entertaining
Modern kitchen with premium finishes
Private garden and terrace, perfect for outdoor relaxation
High-quality fixtures and designer touches throughout

Community Amenities:

Access to the world-renowned Polo Club and equestrian facilities
Swimming pools, fitness centers, and spa services
Fine dining options and café experiences within the resort
24/7 security and gated community for peace of mind
Landscaped gardens and walking trails for leisure and recreation

Location Highlights:

Prime position in Dubai Land, combining tranquility with convenience
Close to major highways for easy access to Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, and business hubs
Near international schools, shopping destinations, and healthcare facilities
Enjoy the perfect blend of a peaceful residential community and urban connectivity.
